summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners plc filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly share repurchases under its €1 billion buyback programme announced 17 February 2026. From 13-17 April 2026, it bought 548,114 ordinary shares on US venues and 365,855 on London venues via Goldman Sachs, with prices ranging ~$95.60-$99.29 and ~GBP 70.55-73.05. Repurchased shares will be cancelled. This open-market programme reduces outstanding equity and returns capital to shareholders. Watch for pace of execution against the €1B ceiling; cancellation timing may support EPS accretion.
